summary: New single-maintainer fork that markets itself on fixing CVE-2026-93753. It may well be correct, but with 246 weekly downloads, no independent review and no track record it is not a whitelisting candidate.
reasoning: Published August 2026; 246 weekly downloads; 0 GitHub stars.
Has SLSA provenance and a publish workflow, so the mechanics are sound.
No independent security review of the fork, and the CVE fix claim is self-asserted.
Adopting an unreviewed fork trades one supply-chain risk for another.
caveats: If the upstream stays unmaintained, revisit in 6-12 months once the fork has adoption and review coverage.

evidence.label: SLSA provenance
evidence.detail: SLSA v1 attestation: builder github-hosted, source alexandroit/stackline-deepmerge, workflow .github/workflows/publish.yml.

evidence.label: Adoption and track record
evidence.detail: Created 2026-08-16; 6 versions; 246 weekly downloads; 0 stars; 2 open issues.

evidence.label: Independent review
evidence.detail: No third-party audit or advisory coverage. The security fix claim has not been verified externally.
